groups.activity: take the Rank 3 reward or buy blueprints, buy the damaged parts

rows.label: Morgha Blueprint
rows.note: free Necraloid Rank 3 pick (competes with Cortege and Necramech mods)

conditions: The Rank 3 free reward is a single pick: take Cortege's blueprint free and buy Morgha's for 8,000 standing, or vice versa.
Vault rotations cycle every 2.5 hours (A-B-C), so if you're farming the damaged parts instead of buying them, a missing one can be up to 5 hours away.
bonuses: Buying the Damaged parts from Loid skips the 3% rotation-locked vault RNG entirely.
